title: Nice except for the white back
text: Nice except for the white back. This is a nice pillowcase when you first get it in the mail but after you use it and wash it you have to iron it if you don't want the white back to show. It is burgundy on one side and white on the other so it was not something I could use on top of my bed because the white is really obvious.
